2. Follow the posted speed limit: Speed limits are clearly posted on road signs. Drivers should always follow the speed limit to ensure safety for themselves and other drivers.

3. Pay attention to warning signs: Warning signs are posted to alert drivers of potential hazards or dangers. Drivers should be alert and pay attention to these signs to ensure safety.

4. Yield to pedestrians and other drivers: Yield signs are posted in areas where drivers need to give the right of way to someone else. Drivers should always yield to pedestrians and other drivers to ensure safety.

5. Stop at stop signs: Stop signs are posted at intersections to regulate traffic flow. Drivers must come to a complete stop at stop signs and yield to other vehicles or pedestrians before proceeding.
